name: Namn med minst två bärare (Statistiska centralbyrån), 31 december 2022
note: The richest of the registers: every name in the Swedish population with two or more
bearers. 411,802 family names, and given names split into every name a person holds
and the one they are addressed by.
The only register found that publishes family names alongside given ones, which is why
this adapter handles surnames at all. Birth registers are public record almost
